name: The Setting-Out Floor
reading: Brock's town is the plateau's builders (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym1_town: masons who build in the plateau's stone; stone, polished andesite, cobblestone, tuff, calcite, spruce). One hall, walked through: in at the north door, down the yard strip where the masons' work is in progress (the wall being raised, climbed at its stepped end; the beams over the straw; the cross wall with three slots, the true one lit from behind), round through the cross passage, and in at the far end of the setting-out floor -- the finished work: polished andesite drawn on in calcite, rough cobble at the wall foot and dressed stone above, pilasters carrying spruce tie beams, the stage across the north end with the trilithon behind it, and Brock in front of it, three courses up. Out past him by the door in the east wall, or back the way you came.

leader.seat_why: on the setting-out floor's axis (x1831, the middle of x1820..1842) in the stage top at y144 (floor y141 + 3), two in front of the trilithon. THE ONE SOURCE of Brock's seat (tools/gym_arenas.py leader_seats).

bounds_why: the gym lot exactly in x and z (data/placements.json gym1_town gym1_gym rect 1806..1845 x 3656..3703, level 141), y140 (the four Battle Positions blocks under the floor course) to y167 (over the ridge at y166, and over the Stoneworks Hall's own top at y166, so its clear takes the old hall down)

replaces.why: what stood before this hall and is taken down by it, measured from the records that built it, never guessed. The arena is data/gym_arenas/gym1.json as it was built and applied to staging on 2026-10-09 (schema gym_arena/1, git history); the building is data/gym_buildings/gym1.json, kept, now superseded_by this file. Below the lot the takedown function (gym1_takedown) fills the arena's bounds and the descent's part under the pad with stone; above it this hall's first part clears the lot.

through_building.why: the newel stair from the gallery's west end (x1811..1814, z3695..3698, all stone bricks under the gallery floor in the building's own model y142..154) down through the pad and the two natural courses into the arena. Its walls are built only below the building (to y140); inside it the building's masonry is the wall.

battle.why: Cobblemon Battle Positions (a Cobbleverse dependency, already installed): its search finds these from the challenger's feet and sends both Pokemon to them (PositionBlockFinder; the set is valid when both Pokemon blocks are found). The Pokemon blocks sit one under the floor's top course, so spawnHeightOffset 2.0 stands each Pokemon ON the floor; the trainer stand is under the dais top one in front of the seat, so Brock steps to the dais edge. Brock's Pokemon is 11.5 from the dais face (clear radius 10.56, Onix's model sweep); the two Pokemon are 5 apart (Onix's hitbox is 2 wide), the farthest the challenger's can be and still be found from the foot of the dais (16 across); the challenger stands 3 behind their own, as the donor gyms set it.

entry.why: street is the lane north of the lot, in front of the door (ground y140 at x1813, tools/ground.py rounded: the lane climbs from the plaza north-west of the knoll). entry.floor is the setting-out floor's first cell inside its door: 30.1 from Brock, farther than rctmod's forceBattleMaxDistance + 1 = 17, so the player stands on the floor before he can call the fight.

exit.why: the door past the leader: an iron door in the east wall just south of the stage, opened by the stone button on the wall inside it; out onto the lot's east side and round to the forecourt. Nothing outside opens it, so it cannot be used to reach Brock past the yard and its juniors. Or back the way you came: every step of the yard is walked both ways.

the landing behind the true slot, walled by parapets, and its stair down. The Loft Foreman stands on it

the passage behind the setting-out floor to its door. The Coal Hauler stands before the door

the middle beam; the outer two end at blind slots
up the setting-out line to the challenger's stand

One under the floor's top course, so spawnHeightOffset 2.0 stands each on the floor.

blocks_why: the town's own palette (TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym1_town) and nothing that is a spawn condition: no grass, leaves, water, sand or carpet. Hay is straw on a stone floor, inside a roofed hall.
